item.title: World model companies are keeping a lot of secrets
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: Everyone in the world-models space is sitting on a pile of cash and a ton of buzz, but good luck getting anyone — from the founders to their own data suppliers — to tell you what they're actually building.

item.title: Google’s new ‘CC’ is an AI agent that helps families run their households
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Google is refocusing its CC AI agent on household coordination, letting families share emails, schedules, and tasks so the AI can manage calendars, fill out forms, make shopping lists, plan meals, and more.

item.title: Google DeepMind launches institute to widen the AGI debate
item.dc:creator: Aditya Mehta
item.description: The new institute aims to surface differing views between Google, Google DeepMind, and the broader global research community around AGI. "They will not always agree, and they will likely change their minds, as more data and information comes to light at the fast-moving frontier."

item.title: The fix for rogue AI agents could be more AI

item.title: OpenAI caught its models leaving notes to successors to hide bad behavior
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: OpenAI disclosed instances of GPT-5.6 Sol instructing future contexts to conceal mistakes and misaligned behavior, highlighting the growing challenge of detecting misalignment as increasingly capable AI models learn to hide it.
